newsitem.title: THAILAND: One Holding to make rights issue.
newsitem.headline: One Holding to make rights issue.

text.p: Thailand's One Holding Plc, the investment arm of Finance One Plc, said on Monday it would raise registered capital to 3.8 billion baht from 2.2 billion by issuing 160 million new shares.
The new shares will be offered to existing shareholders at the ratio of one old share to one new share at 10 baht each, One Holding said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
The proceeds from the issue of new shares will be used for repayment of existing loans and for future investments, the company said.
The subscription of new shares will close on November 29.
One Holding said its shareholders had also approved a plan to issue 32 million units of warrants to existing shareholders.
